name: The Shillelagh
intro: An Irish-American pub in West Orange, New Jersey. Join us for live music, a pint, and a seat at the bar. Everyone is welcome.
story:
Since 1967, the Order of the Friendly Sons of the Shillelagh – Essex Division has been a pillar of the West Orange community. We are an Irish-American cultural and social organization dedicated to preserving and celebrating our Irish heritage, fostering fellowship, and sharing our traditions with the community at large.

Located on Prospect Avenue in West Orange, New Jersey, our clubhouse is home to The Shillelagh, a public pub and kitchen where friends, families, and neighbors come together to enjoy good food, drinks, live music, sports, and Irish hospitality. On Friday and Saturday nights, we welcome local and regional musicians to our stage, continuing our long-standing tradition of supporting live music.

Community service and charitable giving are at the heart of our organization. Through our Foundation, a registered 501(c)(3) charitable organization, we host and support a wide variety of charitable initiatives, cultural events, and community outreach programs throughout the year. These include our annual Frank Schott Blood Drive, fundraising for childhood cancer research through St. Baldrick’s, and numerous other endeavors that benefit our local community and beyond.

For more than half a century, the Shillelagh has brought people together through a shared appreciation of Irish culture, music, camaraderie, and community service. Whether you're stopping in for a pint, enjoying a night of live music, or joining us in support of a charitable cause, there's always a place for you at the Shillelagh.
